SOURCE: The Canadian Almanac and Directory, 1917 and 1918 editions,
        table 'POST OFFICES AND RAILROAD STATIONS IN CANADA'.
        Internet Archive items canadianalmanacd0000unse_y6g6 (1917) and _x3a0 (1918).
        Edition years read from the running headers ('1917]' and '1918]'), because the Archive's
        metadata gives 1848, the series start date, for both.
        Full djvu text downloaded and searched 2026-09-06; only these lines were read out.

=== 1917 edition, line 121242 ===
Kanauaskis . 

Kanata . 

Kanawana . 

Kandahar . 

Kannon  . 

=== 1918 edition, line 123122 ===
Kananaskis . 

Kanata . 

Kanawana . 

Kandahar . 

Kannon  . 

NOT RECORDED: the columns beside the name -- the railroad on which located, or the nearest
railway station. The OCR breaks this table into separate column runs and the rows cannot be
aligned to their values with any confidence. The 1915 Post Office report's mail-route line
'Kanawana -- St. Sauveur des Mont[s]' is the reliable statement of the connection.

================================================================================
ADDED 2026-09-06, LATER THE SAME DAY: THREE MORE EDITIONS, AND A LONGER RUN.

A second pass found Kanawana in three further editions of the same table, which extends the
office's documented life by nearly forty years.

=== 1943 edition (item canadianalmanacd0000unse_y9h2, line 50198) ===
tdkananaskis..... Calgary W....Alta/535-225 
Kanasuta........ Ponbiag...)..<0%0% Q/699 7 
Kanawana,...... Terrebonne...... Q|St. Sauveur 529 or 
Piedmont 535 
*Kandahar ...97|Humboldt.. .Sask/535-156 

This edition's columns are legible where the 1917 and 1918 ones were not. Reading across:
post-office name; electoral district or county; province; and "RAILROAD ON WHICH LOCATED, OR
NEAREST R.R. STATION". So Kanawana is in TERREBONNE county, Quebec, with St. Sauveur (line 529)
or Piedmont (line 535) as its railway station. The name carries no population figure, which in
this table marks an unincorporated place.

=== an edition of the early 1950s (item canadianalmanacd0000unse_h4a6, line 120443) ===
t  Kanasuta . 

Kanawana . 

=== an edition of the mid-1950s (item canadianalmanacd0000unse_o8e8, line 98271) ===
tKanasuta . 

Kanawana . 

ON THE TWO EDITION YEARS: the Internet Archive metadata gives 1848 for every volume in this
series, and neither of these two carries a legible year on the pages recovered. h4a6 prints
calendars for 1951 and 1952 and a "1951, Gregorian Calendar" line; o8e8 prints calendars for
1954 and 1955 and a "1954, Gregorian Calendar" line. That places them in the early and the
mid 1950s respectively and no closer. They are NOT dated more precisely here.

WHAT THIS CHANGES: the office is documented from at least 1915 to the mid-1950s, not to 1918.
